name: Roger's Apple
completion_action_text: To complete: use Roger's Apple, then talk to Roger.

journal.raw:
Talk to Roger.
Press the hotkey I to open your inventory, navigate to the Use tab, and double-click Roger's Apple to consume it. Then, talk to Roger.
You learned how to use items! This will make life much easier!

notes: MeowDB marks this quest with completionAction "use-rogers-apple": the completion condition is using Roger's Apple, then talking to Roger. It gives no EXP, mesos or items (MeowDB: "Talk quest, no items required or rewarded.").
gaps: MeowDB shows no "On accept" (quest start) dialogue for this quest.
MeowDB has no maximum level for quests (max_level is null).
MeowDB has no map-visit objectives or per-objective map restrictions for quests.
MeowDB does not say which "On completion" lines are shown before vs after the reward is given, or how dialogue pages are split into NPC chat windows.

MeowDB lists no items given on acceptance (acceptItems is empty) and no "On accept" dialogue, but the completion stop-dialogue says "Eat the Roger's Apple I gave you". MeowDB does not record how many Roger's Apples Roger gives or exactly when.
